walk.zh: 小步挪动，眼睛锁在前面。
walk.en: Small steps forward, eyes locked straight ahead.

walk.zh: 我边走边看，一片叶子也不漏。
walk.en: I walk and watch; not one leaf escapes me.

walk.zh: 触须晃着，替我照看两边。
walk.en: My ribbons sway, keeping watch on either side.
My steps are light enough to leave the grass still.

walk.zh: 我倒着走，因为还想看你。
walk.en: I walk backwards because I still want to see you.
My eyes never blink, yet my feet keep moving.

walk.zh: 绕过石头，目光还粘着你。
walk.en: I round a stone, my gaze still stuck on you.

walk.zh: 糟糕，我踩到自己的触须。
walk.en: Oops—I just stepped on my own ribbon.
Slow down; I need to study every single leaf.
Level twenty legs carry me quite steadily.
I don't watch the road; I watch the world.

walk.zh: 走着走着，盯上一只蝴蝶。
walk.en: Mid-stride, I fix my stare on a butterfly.

idle.zh: 我盯着你，已经盯了很久。
idle.en: I have been staring at you for a long while.

idle.zh: 别动，我快把你的样子记住了。
idle.en: Hold still; I'm nearly done memorizing your face.
I don't blink—it's simply a habit of mine.

idle.zh: 看过的东西，我都忘不掉。
idle.en: Nothing I have looked at ever leaves my mind.

idle.zh: 这只蝴蝶的翅膀，纹路真细。
idle.en: This butterfly's wing has such fine patterns.

idle.zh: 安静点，我在数你的睫毛。
我的眼睛很大，装得下很多。
idle.en: My eyes are large; they hold a great deal.

idle.zh: 站着不动，才能看得更远。
idle.en: Standing still lets me see farther.

idle.zh: 你的呼吸，我数到第十二次。
idle.en: Your breathing—I have counted twelve times now.

idle.zh: 触须在风里，像两根天线。
idle.en: My ribbons in the wind look like two antennae.

idle.zh: 我歪着头，这样看得更清楚。
idle.en: I tilt my head; things look clearer this way.

idle.zh: 有人经过，我要看到最后。
idle.en: Someone is passing; I must watch until the end.

idle.zh: 我把刚看到的一切排好顺序。
idle.en: I sort everything I just saw into order.
Staring this long has made my eyes ache.

look_player.zh: 你刚才眨了一下眼，我数着。
look_player.en: You blinked just now, and I counted it.

look_player.zh: 你的脸上有三个小斑点。
look_player.en: There are three small marks on your face.
Don't turn away; I'm only halfway through looking.

look_player.zh: 你的帽子歪了，右边一点。
look_player.en: Your hat is crooked—a little to the right.

look_player.zh: 我这样看你，你会不舒服吗？
look_player.en: Does it bother you when I stare like this?

look_player.zh: 你手上有茧，是常干活的。
look_player.en: Your hands have calluses; you work often.

look_player.zh: 我在看你的影子怎么动。
look_player.en: I'm watching how your shadow moves.

look_player.zh: 你和他不一样，我记住了。
look_player.en: You are not like him; I have memorized that.
Don't cover your face; I want the whole view.
Your eyes keep dodging mine—why is that?

look_player.zh: 我盯着你，因为你先看我。
look_player.en: I watch you because you watched me first.

look_player.zh: 你身上有铁味，还有草味。
look_player.en: You smell of iron, and of grass as well.

look_player.zh: 再站一会儿，我就看完了。
look_player.en: Stand a moment longer and I'll be finished.
When you smile, your teeth look very white.

tempted.zh: 那东西在动，我要看清楚。
tempted.en: That thing is moving; I must see it clearly.
It's bright and reflective—let me get closer.

tempted.zh: 你手里那个，能给我看看吗？
tempted.en: That thing in your hand—may I look at it?

tempted.zh: 一只没见过的虫，别挡视线。
tempted.en: An unfamiliar bug—don't block my view.
I follow wherever your finger points.
Something's happening; I must watch it all.

tempted.zh: 新鲜的玩意，我挪不动脚。
tempted.en: Something new—and my feet won't move on.
Wave it about and I'll come along with you.
Just one look—only one, I promise.

collide.en: You bumped me and now my view is blurred.

collide.zh: 退后，你挡着我的目标了。

collide.en: You're pinning one of my ribbons down.
Don't push; I wasn't done looking.

collide.zh: 撞一下，我的眼睛都没眨。
collide.en: You bumped me and my eyes never blinked.
You block the light, so I'll just watch you.
Move half a step—just half a step.

collide.zh: 我的身体很轻，一碰就偏。
collide.en: My body is light; one touch sends me sideways.

collide.zh: 你的靴子压到我的脚趾。
collide.en: Your boot came down on my toe.

collide.zh: 撞了我，你得站好让我看。
collide.en: Since you bumped me, stand still and be examined.

mate.zh: 我们对着看，谁先眨眼谁输。
mate.en: Let's stare at each other; whoever blinks first loses.

mate.zh: 你的眼睛比我小一点，很可爱。
mate.en: Your eyes are a little smaller than mine—quite cute.

mate.zh: 我看着你，你也看着我，正好。
mate.en: I look at you and you look at me—perfect.

mate.zh: 我把触须递过去，轻轻碰。
mate.en: I offer my ribbon and touch yours gently.

mate.zh: 我们并排坐着，看同一方向。
mate.en: We sit side by side, looking the same way.
Don't worry; my stare does no harm.
You blinked—this round goes to me.

mate.zh: 我把看到的都讲给你听。
mate.en: I'll tell you everything I have seen.

mate.zh: 以后你看左边，我看右边。
mate.en: From now on you watch left and I'll watch right.

mate.zh: 靠过来，我们的影子并成一个。
mate.en: Come closer; our shadows merge into one.

pickup.zh: 这枚小石子，花纹很好看。
pickup.en: This pebble has a rather lovely pattern.
I pick it up to examine it properly.
Someone lost a button; I'll keep it safe.
A shiny flake stuck to my hand and won't shake off.

pickup.zh: 这纸条上写着字，我认得。
pickup.en: There are words on this note, and I can read them.
I found a feather, and it weighs almost nothing.
I tuck it under myself to hide it.

pickup.zh: 这粒种子，我先替你保管。
pickup.en: This seed—I'll look after it for you.
What I see, I keep—those are my rules.

pickup.zh: 我捡起来，对着光照了照。
pickup.en: I pick it up and hold it to the light.

target_acquire.en: I'll fix it in my sight before I move.

target_acquire.zh: 那只虫一直在偷看，就是它。
target_acquire.en: That bug kept peeking—it's the one.

target_acquire.zh: 它刚才撞了我一下，记住了。
target_acquire.en: It bumped me earlier, and I remember.
Target confirmed; my eyes will not leave it.
Give me three seconds of looking, then I'll decide.

target_acquire.zh: 它的动作有规律，我看懂了。
target_acquire.en: Its movements follow a pattern, and I see it.
Whoever messed up the grass answers to me.

target_acquire.zh: 锁定，别让它出我的视野。
target_acquire.en: Locked on—don't let it leave my sight.

target_acquire.zh: 它躲到树后，我可还看得见。
target_acquire.en: It hid behind a tree, but I still see it.
Hold it in my stare while I gather strength.

targeting.en: I can see every step you take.

targeting.zh: 别想绕到后面，我的触须在。
targeting.en: Don't try to circle behind; my ribbons are there.
Keep backing up and I'll come closer.

targeting.zh: 眼睛酸了，我也不会移开。
targeting.en: Even if my eyes ache, I won't look away.
The moment you hesitate, I have you.

targeting.zh: 我的目光落在你肩上，很沉。
targeting.en: My gaze rests on your shoulder, and it's heavy.
Stop waving that about; it makes my head ache.

targeting.zh: 你跑得挺快，可我看得更快。
targeting.en: You run fast, but I watch faster.
Whoever blinks first will lose first.
One more step and I'll use my power.

melee_attack.en: One glare from me and your head throbs.
A push of thought and you lose your footing.
Don't struggle; my stare is very heavy.
I have pinned your shadow down.
This blow rings inside your mind.

melee_attack.zh: 我抬起手，空气就挤过来。
melee_attack.en: I raise a hand and the air presses in.
Keep your eyes open; it hurts less.

melee_attack.zh: 我的头一歪，你的膝盖就软。
melee_attack.en: My head tilts and your knees go weak.

melee_attack.zh: 小看我的人，都摔过一跤。
melee_attack.en: Everyone who underestimated me has fallen once.
My power makes no sound, yet it has arrived.

spawn.zh: 我从陆地冒出来，先看四周。
spawn.en: I rise on land and survey my surroundings first.

spawn.zh: 二十级，眼睛已经很利了。
spawn.en: At level twenty my eyes are already sharp.
There's plenty stirring here, so I'll stay.

spawn.zh: 刚睁眼，就盯上了一只鸟。
spawn.en: I just opened my eyes and fixed on a bird.
You're watching me? Then I'll watch you first.
This ground is flat and the view is good.

spawn.zh: 我从远处走来，走了很久。
spawn.en: I walked here from far away, a long way.

spawn.zh: 放松点，我不过是在观察。
spawn.en: Relax, I am only making observations.

spawn.zh: 阳光太刺眼，我眯一会儿。
spawn.en: The sun is too bright; I'll squint a while.

spawn.zh: 有新的味道，我得记下来。
spawn.en: There's an unfamiliar scent I need to record.

spawn.zh: 我停在这儿，因为有人经过。
spawn.en: I stop here because someone is passing by.
It's quiet here—ideal for staring at things.

generic.en: It hurts, but I will not close my eyes.
Strike me and I see you even more clearly.
One of my ribbons has bent.
Forty hit points won't last many blows.
Not the face—I still need to watch things.
The pain has blurred my field of view.

generic.zh: 我后退，但眼睛还在你身上。
generic.en: I step back, yet my eyes stay on you.

generic.zh: 我的身体轻，被打得直转。
generic.en: My body is light; the hit spun me around.

generic.zh: 好疼，我要把你记在心上。
generic.en: That hurt; I'll keep you in mind for it.

fire.zh: 火光太亮，我的眼睛在痛。
fire.en: The flames are too bright and my eyes burn.

fall.zh: 摔下去时，我一直在看地面。
fall.en: As I fell, I kept watching the ground.

drown.zh: 水进了眼睛，看不清楚了。
drown.en: Water got in my eyes; everything is blurred.

explosion.zh: 响声把我震得忘了在看什么。
explosion.en: The blast shook the sight right out of me.

projectile.en: An arrow came straight at my eye.

magic.en: Another spell coils around me, and it's loud.

starvation.zh: 饿得眼睛发花，看什么都不清。
starvation.en: Hunger blurs my eyes; nothing looks clear.

lightning.zh: 白光一闪，我什么都没看清。
lightning.en: A flash of white and I saw nothing at all.

void.zh: 下面什么都没有，我的目光也抓不住。
void.en: There's nothing below, and even my gaze can't grip.
